title: Rhodochrosite gear
description: New equipment that will give you vitality !
body:
![rhodochrosite gear by kheyde](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a90cdc85f3b425985332fc81696055371fd9763.png)

![stuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d98d84df932676b2f4eab71f5866bb6f88b69b1e.png)

This new rhodochrosite equipment, along with the new ore used to obtain it, will be your best ally in your survival environment! It's durable enough to find diamonds and will grant you two additional maximum health points (stacking) to make it easier to fight tough enemies.

Introducing Rhodochrosite Ore:
You can find this ore mined from diorite and located in warm biomes in Minecraft (the Nether doesn't count, obviously).

The raw ore behaves exactly like iron, in a furnace or blast furnace! The ore is also affected by the Fortune and Silk Touch effects.
